long_biography.plain_text:
Flex-N-Gate remains under Shahid "Shad" Khan's private ownership decades after he combined it with Bumper Works. As chief executive, he has directed the manufacturer beyond the original bumper business into a broader automotive-components group with operations across several countries.

Professional sport became a separate field of long-term ownership. Khan acquired the Jacksonville Jaguars and Fulham Football Club, serving as chairman of the English club. He and his son Tony also launched All Elite Wrestling. American football, English football and wrestling now sit beside the industrial company, where Khan continues as owner and chief executive.
